messages:
Priya: quick async — can we confirm owners and any blocking deps for the Optimize toolkit delivery? target: canary by EOW. main items: quant recs, batching/cache defaults, and regression alerts.
Alex: infra ok to own the canary deploy window. prefer Tue morning 10-12 PST. I need final image tags and rollout config by Mon EOD. :thumbsup:
Maya: I can own the quant perf numbers. will run final perf matrix on monday. question: which models are in-scope for this pass?
Priya: in-scope: rwd-llama-13b-ql, rwd-tiny-quant, and the p3 family gated variants. prioritize seq<=1024 for baseline.
Jon: FYI ran a quick smoke on rwd-tiny-quant with the new kernel patch — saw p50 increase ~8% for seq>1024. haven't triaged. flagging as a possible regression. :eyes:
Maya: ack Jon, can you paste the gist of the perf run? a short snippet helps.
Jon: gist: ```
model: rwd-tiny-quant
seq: 1536
p50_before: 42ms
p50_after: 46ms
notes: KV cache alignment off by 16 for this run
```
Alex: infra needs a clear rollback plan if we see regressions in canary. suggested rollout yaml: ```yaml
rollout:
  strategy: canary
  initial_percent: 10
  watch_window: 15m
  metrics:
    - latency_p50
    - error_rate
```
Priya: ownership: Maya -> quant perf + triage Jon's regression, Alex -> deploy & rollback config, Jon -> triage regression & create a short repro, Priya -> docs + final prompt sets. ci-bot: please run the canary smoke job once we cut the canary image.
ci-bot: scheduled job create-canary-smoke on Tue 10:05 PST (id: job-8921). will post status in thread.
Maya: I'll start triage Monday AM, if it's kernel alignment I can try the alignment patch and rerun. can also reduce seq target for the initial canary if needed.
Jon: I can produce a minimal repro and link it here by monday noon.
Priya: action items: 1) Maya — final perf matrix (Mon EOD). 2) Alex — confirm rollout yaml + image tags (Mon EOD). 3) Jon — repro + triage (Mon noon). 4) Priya — docs + prompt set (Mon EOD). if any blocker, ping me directly.
Alex: noted. I'll add the rollout yaml to the deploy PR and tag @Priya when ready.
Maya: :thumbsup:
Priya: thanks team — short sync only, will follow up with a tiny meeting invite if triage requires it. good to close here for now.
